structured.answer: I'd go with Harel's "עוקב מדד S&P 500" track (קופה 8211? no, 13414): it's the S&P thing everyone at work talks about, Harel's a name I know, the fee "0.56% מהחיסכון" was about as low as anything I saw, and it showed 13.7% for 3 years and 11.92% for 5. I'm fairly sure, but I didn't really get the deposit-fee bit or the yellow ring.

stuck.where: Screen 1, the row of track chips under "במה הכסף מושקע"
stuck.why: There were about 16 chips like 'אג"ח סחיר', 'משולב סחיר' and 'הלכה'. I didn't know what most of them were, so I left it on 'הכול'.

Every company lists the same tracks with the same 0.5–0.7% fees, so it all blurred together. Around screen 6–7 I'd lost which company I was even looking at because the company header had scrolled away. That's where I stopped.
Their 'עוקב מדדים - גמיש' showed 26.39% for 3 years, more than Harel. That tempted me, but I don't know what 'גמיש' means and I trust Harel's name more.
The S&P one says 99% מניות and 99% מט"ח. I wasn't sure if 99% foreign currency is good or scary.

findings.what: Every row repeats 'מהחיסכון' and 'מההפקדות', plus 'מניות' and 'מט"ח' and '3 שנים / 5 שנים', so I keep re-reading the same words to find the one number that's different
Once the company header row scrolls away I don't know which company I'm looking at. The table header stays stuck at the top but the company name doesn't
Lots of rows just say 'פחות מ־3 שנים' where the return should be, so I can't compare them and I'm not sure what it means
The fees only show as tiny percentages, nothing in shekels, so 0.56% vs 0.73% looks like nothing to me
findings.where: Fee column and the company headers

findings.what: There's no 'start here' or anything recommended, just 143 tracks that look the same. I'd almost rather do nothing today
The rings' colours only make sense if you match them to the tiny dots next to the numbers, and I'm not sure I read them right
The track filter chips use words I don't know ('משולב סחיר', 'אג"ח ממשלתי', 'עוקב מדדים - גמיש'), with no explanation
The underlined numbers look like links, but I wasn't going to tap them
